sceneUI:
zsh — my-first-page
$ git status modified: index.html（改动尚未完成） ⚡ 正式环境登录失败，需要切换到 hotfix/login $ git stash push -m "首页改动尚未完成" Saved working directory and index state On main: 首页改动尚未完成 $ git checkout hotfix/login Switched to branch 'hotfix/login'

zsh — my-first-page
$ git stash list stash@{0}: On main: 首页改动尚未完成 stash@{1}: WIP on main: a1b2c3d 首页基础版本 编号越小越新，pop 默认取 stash@{0}

zsh — my-first-page
$ git checkout main Switched to branch 'main' $ git stash apply stash@{0} On branch main Changes not staged for commit: modified: index.html Changes restored to the working tree 改动已恢复，确认无误后再执行 drop
🛠 首页改动尚未完成 stash push → 📦 stash@{0} → 处理其他任务 → 🛠 stash apply 恢复

$ git stash list stash@{0}: On main: Home page changes have not been completed stash@{1}: WIP on main: a1b2c3d Home page basic version The smaller the number, the newer it is. Pop defaults to stash@{0}

🛠 Home page changes not yet completed stash push → 📦 stash@{0} → Handle other tasks → 🛠 stash apply restore

parts.desc: 尚未 commit 的改动，可通过 stash 临时保存
parts.desc_en: Temporarily stores uncommitted changes so you can switch context without committing them

parts.desc: 最后一次 git stash push 保存的改动；未指定时 pop 默认取它
parts.desc_en: The most recent stash. git stash pop uses this entry by default unless you name another one.

parts.desc: 每次执行 git stash push 后，已有记录的编号依次增加
parts.desc_en: Each git stash push creates a new entry at the top of the stack.

parts.desc: 编号越大表示记录越早；应及时确认是否恢复或删除
parts.desc_en: Higher numbers refer to older entries; restore or drop them once they are no longer needed.

variants.demo: git stash push -m "首页改动尚未完成"
variants.demo_en: git stash push -m "Home page changes have not been completed"
variants.when: 需要暂存改动后切换任务；不会推送到远程
variants.when_en: When you need to set aside local changes before switching tasks; a stash is not pushed to the remote

variants.when: 查看已有的 stash 记录
先恢复但保留备份，确认后再 drop
variants.when_en: Restore first but keep the backup, then drop after confirming

variants.when: 恢复改动，同时保留 stash 记录
variants.when_en: When you want to restore the most recent stash while retaining it

use.t: 临时切换任务前，用清楚的说明收起未完成改动
回来后先放回改动并确认内容，再继续修改
忘记收过什么时，用列表查看已有记录和说明
任务完成后仍要 Commit，不要长期依赖 Stash 保存成果

dont.t: 把 Stash 当成正式版本或远端备份
不写说明就连续收起多次，之后无法判断每一份是什么
恢复后没有检查内容，就直接删除 Stash 记录
长期把重要成果放在 Stash 中，却一直不 Commit

lessonPractice.title: 功能改到一半要临时切分支修 Bug，其中还有刚新建、尚未跟踪的文件。怎样使用 Stash 更稳妥？

options.label: 先看状态，确认包含哪些文件，带说明贮藏，恢复后再逐项检查
options.feedback: 状态检查能发现未跟踪文件，清楚说明和恢复验收避免拿错或遗漏临时现场。

options.label: 把重要成果长期放在 Stash 里，当作正式版本和远端备份
options.feedback: Stash 是本地短期中转，不具备清楚版本历史和远端备份能力。

options.label: 直接 Stash 并假设新建文件一定会一起收起，不再查看状态
options.feedback: 未跟踪文件默认可能不被包含，切换前必须确认实际收起范围。

en.title: A half-finished feature must pause for a bugfix and includes newly created untracked files. How can Stash be used safely?

options.label: Inspect status, confirm included files, stash with a description, and review after restoring
options.feedback: Status reveals untracked files, while a clear description and restore review prevent loss or confusion.

options.label: Keep important results in Stash long-term as formal versions and remote backup
options.feedback: Stash is local short-term transport without clear version history or remote backup.

options.label: Stash immediately and assume every new file is included without checking status
options.feedback: Untracked files may not be included by default, so actual scope must be confirmed before switching.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先展示 git status，指出已跟踪和未跟踪改动，再用包含任务名称的说明创建 Stash，并确认工作区干净。修复完成后恢复但先不删除记录，检查内容无误后再清理；正式成果必须 Commit。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Show git status and distinguish tracked from untracked work, then create a stash with the task name and confirm a clean workspace. Restore without immediately dropping it, verify contents, then clean up; formal results require a commit.

Stash is only suitable for temporarily putting away unfinished changes to facilitate switching branches or handling urgent matters. It is not an official version, nor is it a remote backup; you still need to Commit when completed.

use.t: Switch branches with a dirty working tree
Test the current branch without local edits
Move a small uncommitted change to another context

dont.t: Build a large anonymous pile of stashes
Assume ignored and untracked files are always included
Apply a stash and ignore resulting conflicts
